name: SuperMarquee | Lite
author: superplugin

sections.description:
Add animated marquee elements (ticker, slider, text, and image animations) easily to your WordPress site.
SuperMarquee is the most flexible marquee plugin for WordPress.

  • Supports both text and images
  • Multiple animation directions
  • Adjustable speed and effects
  • Responsive and lightweight

Upgrade to the Pro version directly from the plugin to unlock even more features!

See live demos

  • Image Showcase
  • Text Showcase
  • Creative Showcase

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 (or later).
sections.installation:
1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress admin under “Plugins”.
  3. Click on the newly created “SuperMarquee Lite” menu item in the left sidebar.
  4. Add marquee elements via shortcode your posts or pages.

More information can be found at the offical documentation at https://www.superplug.in/supermarquee-wp/docs
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

After activation, you’ll find new options under “SuperMarquee Lite” in the admin area. Configure your marquee and insert it using the provided shortcode.

Is the plugin free?

Yes! All core features are free. For advanced features, you can upgrade to the Pro version.
